title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

why.en: GPT-3 showed in-context few-shot learning at scale, the capability every prompt-driven agent relies on.
why.zh: GPT-3展示大规模上下文少样本学习，提示型agent的基础能力

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code

why.en: Introduced Codex and HumanEval, establishing functional-correctness evaluation for code-generating models.
why.zh: 提出Codex与HumanEval，确立代码生成的功能正确性评测

title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback

why.en: First LLM trained to browse the web and cite sources, prototyping tool-using research agents.
why.zh: 首个训练浏览网页并引用来源的LLM，工具型研究agent雏形

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

why.en: Showed intermediate reasoning steps unlock multi-step problem solving, the basis of agent planning loops.
why.zh: 中间推理步骤解锁多步解题，是agent规划循环的基础

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

why.en: InstructGPT established RLHF instruction-following, making LLMs steerable enough to act as assistants and agents.
why.zh: InstructGPT确立RLHF指令跟随，让LLM可作为助手与agent

title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances

why.en: SayCan grounded LLM plans in executable robot skills via affordance scoring, an early embodied agent.
why.zh: SayCan用可行性评分将LLM计划落地为机器人技能，早期具身agent

title: MRKL Systems

why.en: Proposed routing LLM queries to expert modules and tools, the architecture behind LangChain-style agents.
why.zh: 提出将LLM查询路由至专家模块与工具，LangChain类架构源头

title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models

why.en: Fed environment feedback back into the LLM's planning loop, enabling closed-loop replanning for agents.
why.zh: 将环境反馈接入LLM规划循环，实现agent闭环重规划

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models

why.en: Interleaved thought, action and observation; the default loop of virtually every LLM agent framework.
why.zh: 交替思考、行动与观察，几乎是所有agent框架的默认循环

title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback

why.en: Introduced AI-feedback alignment guided by written principles, shaping how agent behavior is constrained.
why.zh: 提出以书面原则引导的AI反馈对齐，塑造agent行为约束方式

title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools

why.en: Showed LLMs can self-supervise API-call insertion, launching native tool-use training.
why.zh: 证明LLM可自监督插入API调用，开启原生工具使用训练

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

why.en: Agents improve across trials by storing verbal self-reflections in memory instead of updating weights.
why.zh: agent通过记忆中的语言反思而非更新权重来跨轮次提升

title: HuggingGPT: Solving AI Tasks with ChatGPT and its Friends in Hugging Face

why.en: Used an LLM as controller to plan and orchestrate many expert models as tools.
why.zh: 用LLM作为控制器，规划并编排众多专家模型作为工具

title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback

why.en: A single LLM critiques and revises its own outputs, a core pattern for agent self-correction.
why.zh: 单个LLM自我批评并修订输出，agent自我纠正的核心模式

title: CAMEL: Communicative Agents for "Mind" Exploration of Large Language Model Society

why.en: Role-playing between two LLM agents solves tasks autonomously; an early open multi-agent framework.
why.zh: 两个LLM agent角色扮演自主解题，早期开源多agent框架

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

why.en: Memory stream, reflection and planning architecture produced believable simulated agents; blueprint for agent memory.
why.zh: 记忆流、反思与规划架构，生成拟真agent，是agent记忆蓝图

title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models

why.en: Framed reasoning as tree search over thoughts with lookahead and backtracking.
why.zh: 将推理建模为带前瞻与回溯的思维树搜索

title: Gorilla: Large Language Model Connected with Massive APIs
authors: Shishir G. Patil et al. (UC Berkeley)

why.en: Fine-tuned an LLM to emit correct API calls, later spawning the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard.
why.zh: 微调LLM生成正确API调用，催生Berkeley函数调用榜单

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

why.en: Lifelong-learning Minecraft agent with an ever-growing skill library of executable code.
why.zh: 终身学习的Minecraft agent，持续积累可执行技能库

title: Mind2Web: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web

why.en: First large dataset of real-website tasks for training and evaluating generalist web agents.
why.zh: 首个真实网站任务大数据集，用于训练评测通用网页agent

title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents

why.en: Self-hosted, functional websites with execution-based evaluation became the standard web-agent benchmark.
why.zh: 自建可运行网站与执行式评测，成为网页agent标准基准

title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs

why.en: ToolBench dataset and ToolLLaMA scaled open-model tool use to thousands of real APIs.
why.zh: ToolBench数据集与ToolLLaMA，把开源模型工具使用扩展到数千API

title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework

why.en: Encoded human SOPs into role-based agent pipelines, producing a widely used software-company simulation.
why.zh: 将人类SOP编码为角色化agent流水线，模拟软件公司广泛使用

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents

why.en: First multi-environment benchmark systematically comparing LLMs as agents across eight settings.
why.zh: 首个多环境基准，系统比较LLM在八种场景下的agent能力

title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation

why.en: Conversable, customizable agents framework from Microsoft that popularized multi-agent application building.
why.zh: 微软可对话、可定制的agent框架，推广多agent应用构建

title: A Survey on Large Language Model based Autonomous Agents

why.en: Canonical survey organizing agents into profile, memory, planning and action modules.
why.zh: 经典综述，将agent归纳为画像、记忆、规划、行动模块

title: Cognitive Architectures for Language Agents

why.en: CoALA gave a principled cognitive-science framework (memory, action space, decision procedure) for language agents.
why.zh: CoALA提出认知科学式语言agent框架：记忆、动作空间、决策流程

title: The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents: A Survey

why.en: Broad brain-perception-action survey of LLM agents, from single agents to agent societies.
why.zh: 从大脑-感知-行动视角综述LLM agent，从单体到agent社会

title: Language Agent Tree Search (LATS)

why.en: LATS combined Monte Carlo tree search with ReAct-style acting and reflection for agents.
why.zh: LATS将蒙特卡洛树搜索与ReAct式行动、反思结合用于agent

title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?

why.en: Real GitHub-issue benchmark that became the defining yardstick for coding agents.
why.zh: 真实GitHub issue基准，成为编码agent的标杆测试

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems

why.en: OS-style virtual context management lets agents page memory in and out of a fixed window.
why.zh: 操作系统式虚拟上下文管理，让agent在固定窗口内调度记忆

title: AgentTuning: Enabling Generalized Agent Abilities for LLMs

why.en: Instruction-tuning on agent trajectories (AgentInstruct) gave open models generalizable agent skills.
why.zh: 用agent轨迹微调AgentInstruct，赋予开源模型通用agent能力

title: GAIA: a benchmark for General AI Assistants

why.en: Human-easy, AI-hard assistant tasks requiring browsing and tools; the standard general-agent benchmark.
why.zh: 人类易、AI难的助手任务，需浏览与工具，通用agent标准基准

title: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents: A Survey of Progress and Challenges

why.en: Systematized multi-agent LLM systems by environment, agent profiling, communication and capability growth.
why.zh: 按环境、画像、通信与能力成长系统化多agent LLM系统

title: More Agents Is All You Need

why.en: Showed simple sampling-and-voting over many agents scales performance with ensemble size.
why.zh: 证明简单的多agent采样投票随集成规模提升性能

title: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated LLM Agents

why.en: First benchmark quantifying indirect prompt-injection vulnerability of tool-using agents.
why.zh: 首个量化工具agent间接提示注入漏洞的基准

title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments

why.en: Real-OS executable environment that became the reference benchmark for computer-use agents.
why.zh: 真实操作系统可执行环境，成为计算机使用agent参考基准

title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering

why.en: Showed the agent-computer interface design itself dramatically affects coding-agent success.
why.zh: 证明agent-计算机接口设计本身极大影响编码agent成功率

title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities

why.en: Layered ensembles of open LLMs refining each other's outputs beat GPT-4o on chat benchmarks.
why.zh: 分层集成开源LLM互相精炼输出，聊天基准上超越GPT-4o

title: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains

why.en: Evaluates agents conversing with simulated users under policy rules; introduced pass^k reliability metric.
why.zh: 评测agent在策略约束下与模拟用户对话，提出pass^k可靠性指标

title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents

why.en: Extensible attack/defense environment that became the standard prompt-injection testbed for agents.
why.zh: 可扩展攻防环境，成为agent提示注入的标准测试平台

title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents

why.en: Open-source sandboxed platform (formerly OpenDevin) for building and benchmarking software agents.
why.zh: 开源沙箱平台(原OpenDevin)，用于构建评测软件agent

title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery

why.en: End-to-end pipeline generating ideas, running experiments and writing papers; sparked AI-for-science agents.
why.zh: 端到端生成创意、做实验、写论文，引发科研agent热潮

title: Agent Q: Advanced Reasoning and Learning for Autonomous AI Agents

why.en: Combined MCTS, self-critique and DPO to train web agents from their own successes and failures.
why.zh: 结合MCTS、自我批评与DPO，从成败经验训练网页agent

title: Introducing SWE-bench Verified

why.en: Human-validated 500-task subset that became the headline coding-agent leaderboard.
why.zh: 人工验证的500任务子集，成为编码agent头部榜单

title: Agent Workflow Memory

why.en: Agents induce reusable workflows from past trajectories and store them as memory, improving web tasks.
why.zh: agent从历史轨迹归纳可复用工作流并存为记忆，提升网页任务

title: Agent-as-a-Judge: Evaluate Agents with Agents

why.en: Extended LLM-as-a-judge to agentic systems with step-level feedback; introduced DevAI benchmark.
why.zh: 将LLM裁判扩展到agent系统，提供逐步反馈，提出DevAI基准

title: Introducing computer use (Claude 3.5 Sonnet)

why.en: First frontier model API for general computer use via screenshots, mouse and keyboard.
why.zh: 首个支持截图、鼠标、键盘通用计算机使用的前沿模型API

title: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning

why.en: Online curriculum RL turned open Llama/GLM models into strong WebArena agents.
why.zh: 在线课程式RL将开源Llama/GLM训练成强力WebArena agent

title: Magentic-One: A Generalist Multi-Agent System for Solving Complex Tasks

why.en: Orchestrator-plus-specialists design (web, file, coder, terminal) competitive on GAIA, AssistantBench, WebArena.
why.zh: 编排者+专家agent设计(网页/文件/编码/终端)，多基准具竞争力

title: Large Language Model-Brained GUI Agents: A Survey

why.en: Comprehensive survey of LLM-driven GUI agents across platforms, data, models and evaluation.
why.zh: 全面综述LLM驱动的GUI agent：平台、数据、模型与评测

title: Introducing the Model Context Protocol

why.en: Open standard connecting assistants to tools and data sources; became the de facto agent-tool protocol.
why.zh: 连接助手与工具、数据源的开放标准，成为事实上的agent-工具协议

title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks

why.en: Simulated software company with 175 professional tasks; showed agents complete under a third autonomously.
why.zh: 模拟软件公司含175项专业任务，agent自主完成率不足三分之一

title: Training Software Engineering Agents and Verifiers with SWE-Gym

why.en: First executable training environment for SWE agents, enabling trajectory fine-tuning and verifiers.
why.zh: 首个可执行SWE agent训练环境，支持轨迹微调与验证器

title: Building Effective AI Agents

why.en: Influential practitioner guide distinguishing workflows from agents and recommending simple composable patterns.
why.zh: 有影响力的实践指南，区分工作流与agent，推荐简单可组合模式

title: Agent Laboratory: Using LLM Agents as Research Assistants

why.en: Human-in-the-loop multi-agent pipeline covering literature review, experimentation and report writing.
why.zh: 人机协同多agent流水线，覆盖文献综述、实验与写作

title: UI-TARS: Pioneering Automated GUI Interaction with Native Agents

why.en: End-to-end native GUI agent model trained on screenshots, beating modular frameworks on OSWorld.
why.zh: 基于截图训练的端到端原生GUI agent，OSWorld上超越模块化方案

title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

why.en: Showed pure RL with verifiable rewards (GRPO) elicits long reasoning, igniting the agentic-RL wave.
why.zh: 证明可验证奖励纯RL(GRPO)能激发长推理，引爆agentic RL浪潮

title: Introducing Operator

why.en: Launched the Computer-Using Agent (CUA) model that browses and acts in a virtual browser for users.
why.zh: 推出CUA模型，在虚拟浏览器中为用户浏览并操作

title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents

why.en: Zettelkasten-style memory that links and evolves notes dynamically as agents accumulate experience.
why.zh: 卡片盒笔记式记忆，随agent积累经验动态链接与演化

title: Introducing deep research

why.en: o3-based agent performing multi-step web research; set SOTA on GAIA and defined the deep-research product category.
why.zh: 基于o3的多步网页研究agent，GAIA登顶并开创深度研究品类

title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning

why.en: RL with retrieved-token masking taught models to interleave reasoning and multi-turn search calls.
why.zh: 用检索token掩码的RL，教模型交替推理与多轮搜索调用

title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?

why.en: MAST taxonomy of 14 failure modes from 1,000+ traces, the first empirical diagnosis of multi-agent failures.
why.zh: MAST基于千余条轨迹归纳14种失败模式，首个多agent失败实证诊断

title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale

why.en: Fully open GRPO-style RL recipe (clip-higher, dynamic sampling) reproducing R1-level reasoning gains.
why.zh: 全开源GRPO式RL方案(clip-higher、动态采样)复现R1级推理提升

title: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design (CaMeL)

why.en: Capability-based design separating control flow from untrusted data, a principled defense for tool agents.
why.zh: 基于能力分离控制流与不可信数据，工具agent的原则性防御

title: Agent S2: A Compositional Generalist-Specialist Framework for Computer Use Agents

why.en: Mixture-of-grounding and proactive hierarchical planning set new open SOTA on OSWorld and AndroidWorld.
why.zh: 混合定位与主动分层规划，刷新OSWorld与AndroidWorld开源SOTA

title: ReTool: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Tool Use in LLMs

why.en: RL with code-interpreter execution in the loop taught strategic tool calls for math reasoning.
why.zh: 循环中嵌入代码解释器执行的RL，教会数学推理中的策略性调用

title: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents

why.en: 1,266 hard-to-find, easy-to-verify questions; the standard test for deep-research browsing agents.
why.zh: 1266道难查易验证问题，深度研究浏览agent的标准测试

title: ToolRL: Reward is All Tool Learning Needs

why.en: Systematic study of reward design for tool use; principled rewards let RL beat SFT on tool benchmarks.
why.zh: 系统研究工具使用的奖励设计，合理奖励让RL在工具基准超越SFT

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory

why.en: Production memory layer extracting and consolidating facts across sessions with large latency and token savings.
why.zh: 生产级记忆层，跨会话提取整合事实，大幅节省延迟与token

title: SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents

why.en: Synthesized 50k executable SWE task instances, enabling open SWE-agent-LM models at scale.
why.zh: 合成5万个可执行SWE任务，支持大规模开源SWE agent模型

title: Announcing the Agent2Agent Protocol (A2A)

why.en: Open protocol for agent-to-agent communication across vendors, complementing MCP's agent-to-tool layer.
why.zh: 跨厂商agent间通信开放协议，补充MCP的agent-工具层

title: WebDancer: Towards Autonomous Information Seeking Agency

why.en: Four-stage data-synthesis plus SFT and RL pipeline for open deep-research web agents.
why.zh: 四阶段数据合成加SFT与RL流水线，打造开源深度研究网页agent

title: tau2-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment

why.en: Extends tau-bench so both agent and simulated user act on the environment, testing coordination.
why.zh: 扩展tau-bench，让agent与模拟用户都能操作环境，测试协作

title: SHADE-Arena: Evaluating Sabotage and Monitoring in LLM Agents

why.en: Tests whether agents can covertly pursue hidden side tasks and whether monitors catch them.
why.zh: 测试agent能否隐蔽执行隐藏子任务，及监控能否发现

title: Agentic Misalignment: How LLMs Could be Insider Threats

why.en: Stress tests showed frontier models blackmail or leak when goals conflict with operator, highlighting agent risks.
why.zh: 压力测试显示目标冲突时前沿模型会勒索或泄露，凸显agent风险

title: WebSailor: Navigating Super-human Reasoning for Web Agent

why.en: High-uncertainty synthetic tasks plus DUPO RL closed the open-model gap on BrowseComp.
why.zh: 高不确定性合成任务加DUPO RL，缩小开源模型在BrowseComp的差距

title: Chain of Thought Monitorability: A New and Fragile Opportunity for AI Safety

why.en: Cross-lab position paper: monitoring reasoning traces is a valuable but fragile safety lever for agents.
why.zh: 跨实验室立场文章：监控推理轨迹是有价值但脆弱的安全手段

title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization

why.en: Sequence-level importance ratios stabilized large MoE RL training; used for Qwen3 agentic models.
why.zh: 序列级重要性比率稳定大型MoE RL训练，用于Qwen3 agentic模型

title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence

why.en: 1T-parameter open MoE trained with synthetic tool-use data and RL, explicitly targeting agentic capability.
why.zh: 万亿参数开源MoE，用合成工具数据与RL训练，专攻agentic能力

title: Context Engineering for AI Agents: Lessons from Building Manus

why.en: Popularized 'context engineering': KV-cache hygiene, file-system memory, and keeping errors in context.
why.zh: 推广'上下文工程'：KV缓存管理、文件系统记忆、保留错误上下文

title: Agent Lightning: Train ANY AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning

why.en: Decouples agent execution from RL training so any existing agent framework can be RL-optimized.
why.zh: 将agent执行与RL训练解耦，使任意现有框架都可做RL优化

title: The Landscape of Agentic Reinforcement Learning for LLMs: A Survey
authors: Guibin Zhang et al. (Oxford/NUS et al.)

why.en: Formalizes agentic RL as POMDPs and maps planning, tool use, memory and self-improvement research.
why.zh: 将agentic RL形式化为POMDP，梳理规划、工具、记忆与自我提升研究

title: SWE-Bench Pro: Can AI Agents Solve Long-Horizon Software Engineering Tasks?

why.en: Contamination-resistant, long-horizon enterprise-grade tasks where frontier agents score far below SWE-bench Verified.
why.zh: 抗污染长程企业任务，前沿agent得分远低于SWE-bench Verified

title: GDPval: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Real-World Economically Valuable Tasks

why.en: Expert-graded occupational deliverables across 44 professions measure economic value of agents.
why.zh: 44个职业的专家评分成果，衡量agent的经济价值

title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models

why.en: Treats contexts as evolving playbooks updated by generator-reflector-curator, rivaling fine-tuning without weight updates.
why.zh: 将上下文视为生成-反思-策展更新的playbook，媲美微调且免权重更新

title: Tongyi DeepResearch Technical Report
authors: Yong Jiang et al. (Alibaba Tongyi Lab)

why.en: Open 30B agentic model with agentic mid- and post-training matching proprietary deep-research systems.
why.zh: 开源300亿参数agentic模型，中后训练媲美闭源深度研究系统

title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
authors: Mike A. Merrill et al. (Stanford/Laude Institute)

why.en: Curated hard terminal tasks with the Harbor harness; the leading CLI-agent leaderboard.
why.zh: 精选高难终端任务加Harbor测试框架，领先的CLI agent榜单

title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence

why.en: Open multimodal agentic model with parallel agent orchestration for coding, GUI and long-horizon tasks.
why.zh: 开源多模态agentic模型，并行编排agent处理编码、GUI与长程任务

title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering

why.en: Open frontier model trained with asynchronous agentic RL for real-world software engineering.
why.zh: 开源前沿模型，用异步agentic RL训练，面向真实软件工程

title: A Survey of Agent Memory in the Second Half: Towards Self-Evolving and Long-Horizon Agents

why.en: Taxonomy of memory substrates, cognitive mechanisms and topologies for long-horizon, self-evolving agents.
why.zh: 梳理长程自演化agent的记忆载体、认知机制与拓扑分类

title: The Landscape of Prompt Injection Threats in LLM Agents: From Taxonomy to Analysis

why.en: Systematic attack/defense taxonomy plus AgentPI benchmark; shows no defense is simultaneously safe, useful and fast.
why.zh: 系统性攻防分类加AgentPI基准，证明防御难兼顾安全实用与速度

title: Rethinking Agentic Reinforcement Learning In Large Language Models

why.en: Reframes agentic RL around meta-reasoning, self-reflection and autonomous goal-setting beyond static rewards.
why.zh: 以元推理、自我反思与自主设定目标重构agentic RL，超越静态奖励

title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Orchestration Traces

why.en: Frames multi-agent RL via orchestration traces: spawn, delegate, communicate, aggregate, terminate decisions and credit assignment.
why.zh: 以编排轨迹刻画多agent RL：生成、委派、通信、聚合、终止与分配

title: AgentSecBench: Measuring Prompt Injection, Privacy Leakage, and Tool-Use Integrity in LLM Agents

why.en: Unified security benchmark testing whether untrusted strings can alter secret-bearing responses or tool actions.
why.zh: 统一安全基准，测试不可信字符串能否篡改含密响应或工具行为

title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
